mediaWork.title: Paradise Lost: The Child Murders at Robin Hood Hills
mediaWork.summaryNotes: A horrific triple child murder leads to an indictment and trial of three alienated teenagers, based on the thinnest of evidence. This film is a chilling look at a modern-day witch-hunt.
